topics.about: how far the designers' restyling goes and whether that or automatic Video.js upgrades matters more: controls whose code the team copies into the project and edits, or controls Video.js maintains and updates
topics.answer: Automatic upgrades matter more. Our designers only need to change colors, fonts, and spacing.

topics.about: which starting look the player has, such as a fuller or more minimal style
topics.answer: No preference, whatever looks good out of the box.
